ClLCD
1→A
1→B
1→C
1→D
1→T
0→ET
0→MA
0→MB
0→MC
0→MD
0→AST
0→BST
0→CST
0→DST
0→S
0→AW
0→BW
0→CW
0→DW
1→TA
1→TB
1→TC
1→TD
Outpt(1,6,"Bar Tapper"
Outpt(2,5,"by Logan Byam"
Outpt(5,1,"Up/Down moves"
Outpt(6,1,"Left slides mug"
Outpt(7,1,"Enter pauses"
Pause
ClLCD
Outpt(2,1,"IIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIII"
Outpt(4,1,"IIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIII"
Outpt(6,1,"IIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIII"
Outpt(8,1,"IIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIII"
Outpt(1,A,"A"
Outpt(3,B,"A"
Outpt(5,C,"A"
Outpt(7,D,"A"
Outpt(T,20,"R"
Outpt(1,19-MA,"D"
Outpt(3,19-MB,"D"
Outpt(5,19-MC,"D"
Outpt(7,19-MD,"D"
Pause
Lbl M
ET+1→ET
Outpt(8,11,ET)
Outpt(8,1,S)
If 19-MA≤A:Then:1→A:0→AST:S+1→S:Outpt(1,19-MA,"  "):0→MA:Outpt(1,19,"D"):1→AW:End
If 19-MB≤B:Then:1→B:0→BST:S+1→S:Outpt(3,19-MB,"  "):0→MB:Outpt(3,19,"D"):1→BW:End
If 19-MC≤C:Then:1→C:0→CST:S+1→S:Outpt(5,19-MC,"  "):0→MC:Outpt(5,19,"D"):1→CW:End
If 19-MD≤D:Then:1→A:0→AST:S+1→S:Outpt(7,19-MD,"  "):0→MD:Outpt(7,19,"D"):1→DW:End
getKy→K
If K==25
Then
Outpt(T,20," ")
T-2→T
If T≤0
Then
1→T
End
Outpt(T,20,"R"
End
If K==34
Then
Outpt(T,20," "
T+2→T
If T≥9
Then
7→T
End
Outpt(T,20,"R"
End
If K==22:Then:Goto E:End
If K==105:Then:Pause:End
If K==24:Then
If T==1:Then:1→AST:End
If T==3:Then:1→BST:End
If T==5:Then:1→CST:End
If T==7:Then:1→DST:End
End
Outpt(1,A," "):A+1→A:Outpt(1,A,"A"
Outpt(3,B," "):B+1→B:Outpt(3,B,"A"
Outpt(5,C," "):C+1→C:Outpt(5,C,"A"
Outpt(7,D," "):D+1→D:Outpt(7,D,"A"
If AST==1
Then
Outpt(1,19-MA," "
MA+1→MA
Outpt(1,19-MA,"D"
End
If BST==1
Then
Outpt(3,19-MB," "
MB+1→MB
Outpt(3,19-MB,"D"
End
If CST==1
Then
Outpt(5,19-MC," "
MC+1→MC
Outpt(5,19-MC,"D"
End
If DST==1
Then
Outpt(7,19-MD," "
MD+1→MD
Outpt(7,19-MD,"D"
End
If A==19 or B==19 or C==19 or D==19:Then:Goto E:End
If AW==1:Then:Outpt(2,TA,"II"):TA+1→TA:Outpt(2,TA,"I$"):End
If BW==1:Then:Outpt(4,TB,"II"):TB+1→TB:Outpt(4,TB,"I$"):End
If CW==1:Then:Outpt(6,TC,"II"):TC+1→TC:Outpt(6,TC,"I$"):End
If DW==1:Then:Outpt(8,TD,"II"):TD+1→TD:Outpt(8,TD,"I$"):End
If TA==19
Then
If T==1
Then
0→AW
Outpt(2,20,"  "
S+3→S
1→TA
End
Outpt(2,20,"  "
1→TA
End
If TB==19
Then
If T==3
Then
0→BW
Outpt(4,20,"  "
S+3→S
1→TB
End
Outpt(4,20,"  "
1→TB
End
If TC==19
Then
If T==5
Then
0→CW
Outpt(6,20,"  "
S+3→S
1→TC
End
Outpt(6,20,"  "
1→TC
End
If TD==19
Then
If T==7
Then
0→DW
Outpt(8,20,"  "
S+3→S
1→TD
End
1→TD
Outpt(8,20,"  "
End
Goto M
Lbl E
ClLCD
Outpt(3,4,"Sorry, you lost"
Outpt(5,8,"Score:"):Outpt(5,15,S)
Outpt(6,9,"Time:"):Outpt(6,15,ET)
Outpt(7,6,"Overall:"):Outpt(7,15,int 100(S/ET)):Outpt(7,17,"%")
Stop
